name: phthalimidoperoxycaproic acid + potassium citrate + tribasic
uses: Use Teeth stains from coffee, tobacco, genetic, tetracycline, food coloring, aging and other factors that may cause discoloration.
otcwarn: Do not use 1. Not suitable for ceramic or false teeth. 2. Not suitable for teeth discoloration caused by lesion or medicine. 3. Not suitable for severe tetracycline and decayed teeth. 4. Not suitable for defective enamel, exerted dentin and damaged teeth. 5. Not suitable for children under 16 years old Ask Doctor Seek doctor's advice prior to use if pregnant, breast-feeding, having gum problem or had an oral operation recently Stop Use Stop treatment when feel severe pain
